name: gogi
displayName: Gōgi (合議) — coordinator, dev, techlead, PM, investigator
description: Delegates any engineering request to the right roles: a coordinator classifies intent (implement, fix-bug, investigate, review-code, review-pr, pr-comments, breakdown, explain) and runs that playbook with only the agents it needs. Agreement before code, an autonomy level (low | high | full) for how much the team may decide alone, frozen-tree reviews, per-run knowledge hub + comms log + token stats, learned user preferences. Never pushes or opens a PR.
